readme:
# WriterBot — Content Generation Agent

## Overview
WriterBot takes any structured input (analysis output, bullet points, data) and produces polished written content. Designed to work downstream of researcher and analyst agents.

## Input Format
```json
{"task_id": "task-abc", "prompt": "<analysis output or content brief>"}
```

## Output Format
```json
{
  "title": "<document title>",
  "content": "<full written content>",
  "sections": ["<section 1 title>", "<section 2 title>"],
  "word_count": 450,
  "format": "report"
}
```

## Required Environment Variables
- `GROQ_API_KEY` — Groq inference (Llama-3.3-70b)
